# Cloud API Support Tier Policy (Synthetic Canary)
Rule S1: Standard tier guarantees 99.90% monthly uptime across 43,200 minutes. Planned maintenance announced 72 hours ahead is excluded from downtime.
Rule S2: Unplanned downtime between 44 and 120 minutes triggers a 10% service credit on the $12,000 monthly contract; above 120 minutes triggers a 25% credit.
Rule S3: Credits apply only to future invoices and never as cash refunds; claims must be submitted within 14 days of incident closure.
Incident Summary: Total outage was 95 minutes, of which 20 minutes were planned maintenance announced 96 hours in advance. Root cause and closure date are not yet logged.
